title: Enable debug console, D3D12 debug+info queue, DRED, DXC, and Agility SDK
purpose: Diagnose white-window crash and modernize the toolchain for DXR by adding logs, device-removed diagnostics, DXC shader compilation, and optionally the DirectX 12 Agility SDK.

steps.detail: Attach a debug console in Debug builds; redirect stdout/stderr; log startup and failures.
Enable D3D12 debug layer + IDXGIInfoQueue breaks on error; log messages to console.
On DXGI_ERROR_DEVICE_REMOVED/HUNG from Execute/Present, query ID3D12DeviceRemovedExtendedData2 to dump breadcrumbs and page faults.
Check HRESULTs for ExecuteCommandLists and Present; if failed, print GetDeviceRemovedReason and DRED outputs, then exit gracefully.
Add DXC to toolchain (NuGet or local): compile DXR shaders with dxc.exe (/T lib_6_3, /Zi in Debug).
Optional: integrate Agility SDK 1.616.x: export D3D12SDKVersion=616 and D3D12SDKPath='\\D3D12\\'; deploy SDK DLLs to that folder next to the EXE.
Add PIX events around swapchain present, AS/SBT build, DispatchRays; confirm capture works.

acceptance: Console shows initialization and per-frame logs
On crash, DRED breadcrumbs and page fault summaries are printed
DXC compiles a test lib_6_3 shader; DXR path gated if DXC unavailable
Agility SDK loads (optional), confirmed by D3D12 SDK version log
references: DirectX 12 Agility SDK – downloads and getting started: https://devblogs.microsoft.com/directx/directx12agility/
